lines.text: La Banque des Entreprises WB Sanctions Questionnaire
La Banque des Entreprises, its subsidiaries and affiliates (collectively “La Banque des Entreprises”) are required to comply with applicable sanctions law and regulations1
imposed by the Netherlands, the European Union, @S well aS other sanctions authority of each jurisdiction where La Banque des Entreprises has operations, such AS for example
the United States (“Sanctions”). As an La Banque des Entreprises client, YOU and YOUr branches/offices and subsidiaries Are expected to refrain from directing transactions to OF
through La Banque des Entreprises and otherwise using La Banque des Entreprises products, funds, accounts Of services in connection with ANY transaction °F activity, directly OF
indirectly involving individuals, entities, aircraft OT vessels that are the subject of Sanctions (“Sanctioned Parties”) aS well aS Sanctioned Jurisdictions (as defined below) 9 where
a transaction or activity would be prohibited for La Banque des Entreprises, and/or would result in a violation of Sanctions by La Banque des Entreprises.
This questionnaire is ONE of the MEANS through which La Banque des Entreprises aims to identify the extent of OUT clients’ activities with certain entities,
jurisdictions and territories and their direct Of indirect engagements with targets of sanctions regimes. We kindly refer YOU to La Banque des Entreprises's
FEC statement published on our website.
Clients are required to provide information about their business activities in or with the countries (or regions as the case may be): Belarus, Crimea, Cuba,
Iran, North Korea, Russia, Sudan, Syria, or the illegally annexed regions of Zaporizhzhia, Kherson, Donetsk and Luhansk in Ukraine (“Sanctioned
Jurisdictions?") and Sanctioned Parties. In this questionnaire Sanctioned Parties shall be understood to include any individual, entity, vessel or aircraft
that is, or is owned by 50% or more or controlled (irrespective of ownership) by one or more persons that are listed on a Sanctions list or is otherwise
target of any Sanctions.
To enable La Banque des Entreprises to document YOUr sanctions €XPOSUrE, the Sanctions Questionnaire is requested to be completed by an appropriate and
authorised representative of your company. The responses provided should ENCOMPASS and be fully applicable to and reflective of all subsidiaries, investments,
joint-ventures, branches and representative offices, incorporated and/or based anywhere in the world, which are owned, controlled and/or managed by YOU. For
the avoidance of doubt this would include subsidiary / subordinate entities which do not have any relationship with La Banque des Entreprises.
Please answer all questions of this document and complete the Sanctions Exposure Confirmation at the end of this document.

Do you or any of your branches/offices, subsidiaries or joint ventures have current or contemplated
activity, directly or indirectly, in, with or involving any Sanctioned Jurisdiction?
For the purpose of this Questionnaire, activity includes, but is not limited to:
a. deriving revenue by selling goods, services to a party in, or otherwise receiving income from a
Sanctioned Jurisdiction;
b. _ incurring expenses by purchasing goods or services from, or providing humanitarian aid to a party
in Sanctioned Jurisdiction;
c. maintaining assets by physical presence, registration, operations, or investments in a Sanctioned
Jurisdiction; or
d. otherwise interacting or dealing with a Sanctioned Jurisdiction including, without limitation,
through transfer, transport, transshipment;
and in each case including, without limitation, through third parties or agents.
Please select “Yes” for any activity, including those activities that are not prohibited by Sanctions, or
specifically authorized by a relevant sanctions authority.

Do you or any of your branches/offices, subsidiaries or joint ventures have current or contemplated
activity, directly or indirectly, in, with or involving the government of Afghanistan, Lebanon, Myanmar,
Venezuela or Zimbabwe or any entity which is more than 50% owned or controlled by such government
(collectively “Government”)?
If “Yes” is selected, please provide further details on the activity (including, without limitation, the name of
the government/government owned/controlled entity, activities, legal obligations or exposures to any of
these governments/government owned/controlled entities, including via third parties such as customers,
representatives, distributors, brokers, agents and the extent of La Banque des Entreprises’s involvement).
Do you intend to use or make available to your branches/offices, subsidiaries, joint ventures or any other
third person, any La Banque des Entreprises accounts, products (including any partial usage of loans),
services, systems, or platforms, directly or indirectly, to conduct any activity with or involving a (i)
Sanctioned Party, (ii) Sanctioned Jurisdiction or (iii) the Government of any of any country as listed in
Question 4 (including any activities that are specifically authorized or not prohibited)?
If “Yes” is selected, please specify La Banque des Entreprises account/product/service Of platform that is
contemplated to be used for such purposes and how this is contemplated to be used.
If “No” is selected, please describe the controls that will be maintained to ensure that La Banque des
Entreprises is insulated from any activity involving the Sanctioned Party, Sanctioned Jurisdiction, or
Government, and is not involved, directly or indirectly, in any such activities. Further, in case you, your
branches/offices, subsidiaries, joint ventures conduct business activity with a Sanctioned Party or Sanctioned
Government, but do not use any La Banque des Entreprises accounts/products/services for this, please
indicate the name of the Sanctioned Party or Government, the sanctions program under which such party is
listed and the percentages of revenue accumulated through the activity at group level and at entity level.
(For Sanctioned Jurisdictions please provide the same information in Part 2 below)
